meta.notes: Seed history assembled from public release tables (TradingEconomics, Investing.com economic calendar, NBS/PBOC releases, x-rates.com). A few series carry known data-quality flags — see per-series 'flag' field. Auto-refreshed on schedule via GitHub Actions using akshare.

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP Growth
gdp_growth.flag: 2025-Q1 and 2025-Q2 not found in sourced snippets — gap.

industrial_production.label: Industrial Production
industrial_production.flag: China does not publish a standalone January reading (combined with Feb around Lunar New Year).

retail_sales.label: Retail Sales
retail_sales.flag: May 2026 was the first y/y decline since Dec 2022.

fixed_asset_investment.label: Fixed Asset Investment (YTD)
fixed_asset_investment.flag: Low confidence: Feb/Mar 2026 (+1.8%, +1.7%) breaks sharply from the surrounding negative trend — possible source-table artifact, not verified against a primary NBS release.

caixin_manufacturing_pmi.label: Caixin Manufacturing PMI
caixin_manufacturing_pmi.flag: Only 4 months found in free sources. Since mid-2025 sometimes co-branded 'RatingDog Manufacturing PMI' — same underlying series.

ppi.label: PPI Inflation
ppi.flag: Swing from -1.9% (Dec '25) to +4.1% (Jun '26) is a genuine, sharply reported reflation story, not a data artifact.

lpr_1y.label: 1-Year Loan Prime Rate
lpr_1y.flag: Held unchanged since May 2025 — 14 consecutive monthly fixings on hold through Jul 2026 per Aug 2026 sourcing.

rrr.label: Reserve Requirement Ratio
rrr.flag: Low confidence on precise level — sources cite 6.2-6.6% inconsistently. No confirmed cut found since May 2025 despite repeated PBOC easing signals.

tsf_flow.label: Total Social Financing (flow)
tsf_flow.flag: Monthly flow, not the TSF stock y/y growth rate — that series wasn't cleanly sourced. Large month-to-month swings are normal (quarter-end/tax-season patterns).

exports_yoy.label: Exports (USD)
exports_yoy.flag: 20-30%+ y/y prints in 2026 look high — plausibly a low base plus tariff front-loading, but not cross-checked against GACC primary data.

usdcny.label: USD/CNY
usdcny.flag: Sourced from x-rates.com aggregated market averages, not PBOC's official daily fixing — directionally reliable, not pip-precise.

property_investment.label: Real Estate Investment (YTD)
property_investment.flag: 2025 monthly series has gaps (Mar 2025 not found).

new_home_prices.label: New Home Prices, 70-City
new_home_prices.flag: Requested as m/m but only a y/y series was reliably sourced — axis is y/y, not month-over-month.

youth_unemployment.label: Youth Unemployment (16-24)
youth_unemployment.flag: All points use the post-Dec-2023 methodology (excludes enrolled students). Jul 2026 jump to 17.9% reflects seasonal new-graduate entry.
